subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: What should the default contract be for completed run-mode subagent sessions: retained history hidden from active surfaces, automatic archive after archiveAfterMinutes, or current keep-mode retention with docs updated?
rationale: Current main, tests, docs, and user expectations disagree, and the fix changes shipped behavior for retained session history, attachments, status visibility, and Control UI lists.

options.title: Retain History, Hide Terminal Rows
options.body: Keep cleanup="keep" as the history-preserving default, but mark completed run-mode children terminal and exclude them from active/default status and session-list surfaces so they cannot look live or block parent workflows.

options.title: Honor Auto-Archive Docs
options.body: Make archiveAfterMinutes apply to completed run-mode subagents by default, preserving transcript archives while removing stale rows after the configured window but changing the currently shipped keep behavior.

options.title: Document Keep-Only Default
options.body: Leave runtime retention unchanged and update docs/UI expectations so users must opt into cleanup="delete" or explicit cleanup commands for archival behavior.

recommendation.title: Retain History, Hide Terminal Rows
recommendation.body: Keep cleanup="keep" as the history-preserving default, but mark completed run-mode children terminal and exclude them from active/default status and session-list surfaces so they cannot look live or block parent workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent local history across the subagent cleanup, registry, session-list, and docs surfaces that need one product contract.
